results.content:
Only three male players have won 20 or more Grand Slam titles. With his victory at the 2023 US Open, Novak Djokovic won his 24th major title, the most in history. Below is a list of the most singles Grand Slam trophies men have won in the Open Era (since 1968)

PlayerTitles
1) Novak Djokovic24
2) Rafael Nadal22
3) Roger Federer20
4) Pete Sampras14
5) Bjorn Borg11
T6) Andre Agassi, Jimmy Connors and Ivan Lendl8
T9) Carlos Alcaraz, John McEnroe and Mats Wilander7 [...] Novak Djokovic, Rafael Nadal, Roger Federer, Bob Bryan and Mike Bryan dominate the titles leaderboard for the Grand Slam tournaments.

TournamentSinglesDoubles
Australian OpenNovak Djokovic (10)Bob Bryan, Mike Bryan (6)
Roland GarrosRafael Nadal(14)Max Mirnyi, Daniel Nestor (4)
WimbledonRoger Federer (8)Todd Woodbridge (9)
US OpenJimmy Connors, Roger Federer, Pete Sampras (5)Bob Bryan, Mike Bryan (5)

### Grand Slam Tournaments Longest Winning Streaks [...] From 2003 Wimbledon through 2023 US Open, Novak Djokovic (24), Rafael Nadal (22) and Roger Federer (20) combined to capture 66 of the 79 Grand Slam titles (83.5%).

During that stretch, only nine other players won at least one Grand Slam title: 

Marat Safin: 2005 Australian Open

Juan Martin del Potro: 2009 US Open

Andy Murray: 2012 US Open, 2013 Wimbledon, 2015 Wimbledon

Stan Wawrinka: 2014 Australian Open, 2015 Roland Garros, 2016 US Open

Marin Cilic: 2014 US Open
